clips.title: The story
paras: Investigating Forsaken incursions in eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind uncovers a tragic massacre deep within the Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The resident druids were poisoned and slaughtered in their sleep by undead agents, leaving their maddened spirits trapped in torment. Alliance adventurers are tasked with granting eternal rest to their slain leaders to soothe the agonizing spiritual blight.

While battling the effects of virulent Forsaken toxins recovered in eastern Ashenvale, the night elf sentinel Kayneth Stillwind was struck by a terrifying waking vision. Beneath the earthen mounds of the nearby Dor'Danil Barrow Den, he witnessed an atrocity: the druids resting within had been quietly poisoned and slaughtered by undead infiltrators. Rather than passing peacefully into nature's embrace, their souls were severed violently from their flesh, warped by unnatural venom into shrieking, errant specters.

Driven mad by the unnatural circumstances of their deaths, the druids' phantoms haunt the subterranean chambers of Dor'Danil, unable to find release. To quiet the echoing anguish beneath the earth, Kayneth bids champions to venture into the depths and strike down the lingering spirits of the circle's three venerable leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak. Only by laying these tortured figures to rest can the restless den begin to heal from the defilement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When I struggled with the Forsaken's poisons, I had a vision. I had a vision of the druids in the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, poisoned... Murdered by the undead! They are now errant ghosts, severed from their bodies and driven mad.
So that the druids' spirits might some day find peace, you must enter the Dor'danil Barrow Den and destroy its once great leaders: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall and Mavoris Cloudsbreak.
Do this, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The anguish of the Dor'danil druids still haunt my dreams, friend. You must destroy their leaders!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I felt the anguish of the Dor'danil Barrows lessen, and knew you had completed your task.
It was grim work you did, friend, for the spirits you destroyed were merely victims of the Forsaken's evil. But with their destruction, let us hope the other maddened spirits find peace.
